name: weapons-r1
note: The first held weapon for the avatar (docs/equipment-plan.md, the in-game prototype, owner 2026-11-13): ONE long sword on the standard weapon footprint: upright, point up, flat-on. Cut to a 128 x 512 canvas with the grip's middle at (64, 448).

long-sword.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game, and the attached OGRE holds a club painted the way this game paints weapons: match their rendering (soft painterly, flat-ish colour with gentle shading, soft thick dark outlines, no texture, no background). SUBJECT: ONE LONG SWORD, a plain knight's arming sword, drawn as a game item for that farm man to hold. It stands perfectly UPRIGHT in the middle of the picture, POINT UP, pommel down, exactly vertical and symmetrical about its centre line, seen flat-on from the side of the blade (the flat of the blade faces the viewer): no tilt, no perspective, no foreshortening. From the bottom: a round brass pommel; a straight grip wrapped in dark brown leather, about as long as a fist is wide and a half; a straight brass crossguard, about three times as wide as the blade; then a long straight double-edged steel blade with a shallow central groove, of even width until it tapers to a point in its last sixth. The blade is about six times as long as the grip. Colours: bright clean steel with one lighter and one darker side, warm brass, dark brown leather. Simple and bold: it is seen about 50 pixels tall on the board, so big plain shapes, no engraving, no jewels, no runes, no glow, no sparkle, no motion lines. COLOUR: never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. The sword fills most of the picture's HEIGHT, with a margin of magenta above the point and below the pommel. ONE SWORD ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no hand, no scabbard, no shadow, no ground, no frame, no text. Every other pixel is pure solid magenta (#FF00FF).
